entries.why_needed: Make observable objects, relations, uncertainty, boundaries and lineage explicit without duplicating Foundation authority.
downgrade_merge_delete_conditions: Merge object types when independent evaluation shows no distinct consumer.
Delete a field only after a migration fixture proves it is not needed for reconstruction.
entries.owner_or_retirement_condition: Owner or independent evaluator may retire a type after recording replacement and lineage.

entries.why_needed: A code diff alone cannot show anomaly, reframing, disposition or unresolved questions.
downgrade_merge_delete_conditions: Merge fields only when the evaluator can recover them from a smaller record.
Delete only with a backward-readable adapter.
entries.owner_or_retirement_condition: Retire only when the formal lifecycle gains an equivalent non-destructive transition authority.

entries.why_needed: Keep acceptance criteria and final verdict outside the Builder write surface.
downgrade_merge_delete_conditions: Never merge the evaluator role into the Builder role.
Narrow criteria only between sealed rounds with Owner authority.
entries.owner_or_retirement_condition: Only Owner/GPT may assign an independent evaluator or retire the plane.

entries.why_needed: Expose a minimal observable contract without binding a model, provider or weight mechanism.
downgrade_merge_delete_conditions: Merge duplicate operations after fixture-backed comparison.
Delete an operation if no successor or evaluator consumes it.
entries.owner_or_retirement_condition: Retire an operation only after its consumer and replacement are recorded.

entries.consumer: R0a to R0b fixture and future compatibility
entries.why_needed: Permit explicit evolution without silently deleting unknown relations or source provenance.
downgrade_merge_delete_conditions: Remove only after all R0a records have an auditable archival replacement.
Never drop unknown relations during migration.
replay_validation: compare adapter output to expected fixture
entries.owner_or_retirement_condition: Retire after a separately authorized migration closes the R0a population and records rollback.

claim_ceiling.text: The budget limits R0 surface area and records retirement conditions; it does not establish capability, cognition, inheritance or performance.
